items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: the guy that wrote the book on creative writing, Dr. Milt Marks, was well known.

ctx.x: Yeah. It goes by so fast. But every time I hear it I go, how did you do that? How did you do that? Did they record you at 33 and then press it at 78 or something? I mean it’s just © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -9-

Well I think I should tell you, I actually studied law. My major was English, my minor was history, and I was a law student. And I had 18 months to get my law degree. And I got the only A in speech class in four years. And I got the only A in the creative writing class in seven years. And so I was a bit of a academic star you know for that, because the guy that wrote the book on creative writing, Dr. Milt Marks, was well known. I think he won a Pulitzer Prize and he’s well known at all university levels,…
It’s a classic, I’ll tell you that.
